paraphrase: Many years, many years, many thousands of years, many crores of hundred thousands of years — O gem-hued one with strong shoulders that felled the wrestlers, may your red feet be kept safe.
speaker: Periyāḻvār
notes: 'pallāṇṭu pallāṇṭu pallāyirattāṇṭu ...' — the devotee prays for the Lord's welfare out of love (maṅgaḷāśāsana).

paraphrase: The Āḻvār calls those who are bound in service to come and sing the benediction with him, and also those who seek the Lord's wealth and those who seek the self (kaivalya), if they will give up those aims and join.
speaker: Periyāḻvār
notes: Commentators read the three invitations as the three kinds of qualified seekers (aiśvaryārthin, kaivalyārthin, bhagavat-kaiṅkaryārthin). Verse range as recalled.
